strongest_wording: From two open-access AURORA-A papers, no unit reaches the qualified level: the evidence supports logic tests of explanation preservation, premise handling and non-identifiability, and shows that the decisive contrast (degradation versus catalytic inhibition) is not resolved by any recorded legal measurement. No value of information, representation or Agent decisions is claimed.

g0_experimental_units.evidence: three level-2 units (PARTIAL_PAIRED_EVIDENCE), zero level 3, zero level 4; one target, one target family, three modes of action, two cell backgrounds with terminal records
g0_experimental_units.limits: known-case sources read by the designer; numeric terminal values, lineage and an alisertib terminal arm are missing; research-level qualification is ASSET_BLOCKED

g1_engineering.evidence: 24 tests: hidden-outcome invariance, condition binding, premise-conditioned updates, non-identifiability, cost accounting, evidence identity, lineage, determinism
g1_engineering.limits: process-level isolation only; synthetic fixtures verify software behaviour and say nothing about biology

g1_biological_discrimination.evidence: design-level chain exists; with the legal replayable menu the compatible set after the published T217D and JB211 outcomes stays {scaffold-type protein loss, catalytic inhibition}; the engagement, kinase-dead and matched alisertib assays have no outcome
g1_biological_discrimination.limits: published outcomes are qualitative; contrast against noise is not assessable; known-case and likely in pretrained memory

information_value.meaning: G2 was not executed; G1 success would not have established it

agent_value.meaning: no LLM was run; no Agent claim of any kind

independent_confirmation.meaning: every record was read by the design; no qualified independent resource was identified

autonomous_discovery.meaning: published AURORA-A results are not newly discovered mechanisms and are one target family
